subject: Dedicated capacity — privileged node fee & commit options for Nimble Health
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@nimblehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity — privileged node fee & commit options for Nimble Health

Hi Anika / Nimble procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a focused breakdown of the Dedicated commitment options we discussed, plus an appendix outlining the single-tenant (privileged node) isolation premium and the KMS/HSM add-on pricing. High-level bullets below to make it easier to review: 

- Baseline Dedicated (shared pool) pricing: $0.85 per vGPU-hour equivalent (throughput adjusted) with standard 99.5% latency SLO for 1–3k concurrent tokens/second.
- Single-tenant privileged node premium: +20% on the baseline unit price for tenant isolation (dedicated control plane, isolated GPU pools, audit log export). This covers separation and extra ops.
- HSM-backed KMS option (optional): $3,500/month flat + $0.12 per vGPU-hour for HSM key access and on-request attestations.
- Throughput SLAs: We can offer 99.9% throughput SLO (p99 latency) for reserved pools sized >= 4 nodes; below that we provide best-effort with burst credits.
- Commit tiers & discounting: 12-month reserved commit (standard) = list price; 24-month commit = additional 8% off; 36-month commit = additional 12% off. Discounts apply to the baseline and are applied before the isolation premium.

Attachment list: nimble_sow_v3.pdf (SOW draft), redwood_priv_isolation_terms.docx (isolation appendix), pricing_model_breakout.xlsx (detailed SKU math).

Action items for Nimble: choose commit length (12/24/36) and pick a preferred pool size (we suggest starting with 4x privileged nodes to hit the 99.9% throughput SLO). If you want, we can prepare a redline-friendly SOW and a one-page commercial term sheet.

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — privileged node fee & commit options for Nimble Health

Diego — thanks for the clear doc. A few items we need clarified before we escalate to legal / security: 

1) Can you give a per-node monthly price (not just %)? Nimble needs line-item numbers for our procurement worksheet.
2) The 20% "privileged node" premium — is that negotiable as a function of commit size? If we do a 36-month reserve across a minimum of 6 nodes, can that premium be reduced?
3) KMS/HSM: we run our own Cloud HSM and would prefer an integration (bring-your-own-key). Do you support BYOK and, if so, is there still a per-hour HSM access fee?
4) On throughput SLAs: can you put the failure modes in the SOW? Specifically, what happens if throughput drops below the SLO due to HW failure versus network/infra?

If you can send per-node/month math and a recommended commercial term (we prefer a single-number TCV that we can push through procurement), we can move to redlines next week.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Director, Procurement | Nimble Health
Anika.Rao@nimblehealth.com

Anika — really helpful questions, thanks. Answers below and I've attached a one-page commercial term sheet that rolls the math into per-node/month and TCV.

Per-node monthly math (4x privileged n1-standard nodes example):
- Baseline equivalent unit: 1 privileged node ~= 96 vGPU-hours/day equivalent (sustained throughput normalized).
- Baseline list: $0.85 per vGPU-hour => ~$2,449/month per privileged node (30-day month) before premiums/discounts.
- Privileged node premium (standard): +20% => $2,939/month per node.
- 24-month commit discount (applies before premium): -8% => adjusted baseline becomes $2,253/month, then +20% premium => $2,704/month per node.
- HSM BYOK: we support BYOK via customer-managed KMS (Cloud HSM) with an integration path — no mandatory HSM access fee if customer provides keys; we do charge a $700/month integration + ongoing $0.05 per vGPU-hour for key access logging and attestation events.

Privilege-premium negotiation: we can reduce the premium to 12% on 36-month, >=6-node commitments and grant a one-time onboarding credit equal to one node-month (applied to first invoice). Example: 6 nodes, 36 months -> per-node/month = baseline after 12% premium and 12% commit discount = see attached term sheet for arithmetic.

Throughput SLA failure modes (high level — will be in SOW appendix):
- Hardware failure (e.g., GPU OOM, device fault): remediation plan = automatic replacement within 2 hours for reserved privileged pools; credit = pro-rated node-month credit equal to impacted node-hours beyond 2-hour repair window.
- Network/infra (egress/bandwidth congestion): we provide diagnostics and remediation assistance; credits are limited to service-level support hours unless Redwood networking is causally at fault.
- Capacity contention (mis-sized pool): if workload exceeds configured pool, automatic overflow to compatible fallback model (with degraded latency) — customers are notified and credits are not issued for policy-driven fallback.

I've attached: pricing_model_breakout_v2.xlsx and a one-page commercial_summary.pdf with TCV options for 12/24/36 months.

Next steps proposal: you indicate preferred commit length and target node count; we'll prepare a commercial mark and a redline-ready SOW for your legal. If helpful, Rishi (cc'd) can join a short call to finalize the premium concessions.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- 36-month, >=6-node commit => privileged node premium reduced to 12% (from 20%).
- One-time onboarding credit: 1 node * 1 month credited back on first invoice.
- BYOK integration fee waived for Strategic customers (we can waive the $700 integration fee if legal signs a standard addendum).

Questions: are we comfortable approving the onboarding credit and BYOK waive at AE level or do we need a sales manager approval? I think the premium concession is within our deal desk range but confirm please.
